openings.title: Annual Category 1 test record packs for independent elevator maintenance contractors

card.reachableChannel: Direct email to the contacts published in the state labor department elevator-contractor licence registry
card.offerScope: A completed Category 1 test record pack per contractor, assembled from its own unit list, ready to file

links.basis: reach: Direct email to the contacts published in the state labor department elevator-co
measured on this offer's own sales: 19 accepted of 120 contacts
12 deal(s) needed, 640 available in the window (640 reachable buyers, each buying about every 365 days, so 1 purchase(s) each in 30 days)
5 days to usable cash against 30 left

facts.value: 640 elevator maintenance contractors hold active licences and are listed with a published email in the state labor department elevator registry; each must file Category 1 test records for every unit it maintains once a year. 120 have been contacted; 520 have not.
Sell A completed Category 1 test record pack per contractor, assembled from its own unit list, ready to file to each buyer.
Pilot invoices (Oct–Nov 2026): 19 contractors each paid $380 for a Category 1 test record pack.

reviews.reasons: Price $380 is a real purchase price paid by this buyer population (19 pilot invoices Oct-Nov 2026, card fact price, EVIDENCE). Conversion 19/120 = 15.8% measured on this offer's own sales to the same population; 520 uncontacted registry contractors x 15.8% = ~82 expected agreements vs 11 needed for $4,000 (11 x $380 = $4,180; plan uses 12 = $4,560). Even the ~10% lower bound of 19/120 gives ~52, so the target holds with wide margin. Each contractor is a separate buyer (one filing per contractor per year), so volume is 520 distinct buyers, not a shared category total. Cost $6 < price $380; card exposure $0 and peakFunding 0 support no up-front capital; net ~$4,488. Settlement: 5 days to first cash (EVIDENCE); receipt day 10 settles day 15, 15 days of slack inside the 30-day window. Delivery is a spreadsheet Brain produces (card delivery EVIDENCE; FULFILMENT link proved PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET), matching the plan's performer.
findings: Ledger/step timing: the deliver step carries its $72 cost on day 8 while the ledger books it on day 16 'after receipts settle'. This is consistent with the card's exposure $0 / peakFunding 0, but the step and ledger should state the same payment timing.

Owner hours: the card records 0.5 human hours per deal (~6 h for 12 deals) that the plan does not show; the contract sets no hours ceiling so it fits, but it should be stated rather than implied zero.
Execution prerequisites SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; they are routine connections, not evidence gaps, and must be connected before day 1.
